preconditions.description: The size of the set n must be between 5 and 10,000 and divisible by 5.
The upper limit b must be at least as large as n and at most 10,000.
The number of hints q must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upToi <= b and 0 <= quantityi <= n for upToi, quantityi in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint must specify a valid range upToi and a valid quantityi within the constraints.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'fair' if any_set_exists(n, b, hints) else stdout == 'unfair'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'fair' if there exists at least one set satisfying all conditions and hints, otherwise 'unfair'.
